subject: Rebook request: demo needs full governance & procurement review
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@bluepeak.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: BluePeak Procurement <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: expand demo audience — security & procurement added

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for scheduling next week’s demo. Two important updates from our side:

- Our Security and Platform teams need to be part of the session — they want to see data flow, key management, and the VPC/on‑prem options.
- Procurement has asked to join to understand contracting milestones and timelines.
- Unfortunately our Head of Infrastructure (Luca) will be traveling Oct 26–27 and cannot make the current slot.

Given those additions and travel, we need to move the demo to a time when all four groups (Product, Security, Platform/Infra, Procurement) can attend. Ideally we lock a single contiguous hour to avoid folks dropping in/out. If that isn’t possible, procurement asked for a short pre‑demo where we can cover terms/timelines.

Can you propose new times? Also, if helpful, we can accept a split session (security + procurement pre‑call, then product demo).

Thanks — Emma
Emma Chen
Senior PM, BluePeak Health
emma.chen@bluepeak.com
+1 415‑555‑0182

----
Attachment: calendar-snapshot.png (image stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: expand demo audience — security & procurement added

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the context. Apologies for the timing conflict with Luca’s travel. We can definitely accommodate the additional stakeholders; below are two approaches we recommend so we keep the run‑rate predictable for your teams: 

Option A — Single extended runthrough (preferred):
- 75 minutes total: 15m procurement + 20m security Q&A + 40m product demo + 10m buffer for decisions
- Pros: everyone hears the same answers; cleaner handoffs for procurement terms
- Cons: longer block required

Option B — Split session:
- 30 min procurement/terms & 30 min security deep‑dive (pre‑call) + 45 min product demo later
- Pros: lets procurement and security focus on the topics that matter most; smaller meeting footprint for each group
- Cons: requires two coordinated blocks and potentially extra follow‑up

Proposed concrete slots (all PT):
- Fri 2026‑10‑29 — 09:00–10:15 (Option A)
- Sat 2026‑10‑30 — 11:00–12:15 (Option A)
- If you prefer Option B, we can do: Thu 2026‑10‑28 16:00–16:30 (procurement) + Fri 2026‑10‑29 09:00–09:45 (product + security)

If any of those work we’ll update the meeting invite and include a short pre‑read for procurement (SLA/pricing summary) and a security appendix for your platform team. We can also send a 6‑minute recorded preview of the product if some stakeholders remain remote/on travel.

I’ve attached the latest deck and a proposed-times.ics so you can see the blocks. Once you confirm, Marissa will own the calendar updates and I’ll prepare the security appendix with Hannah.

> On 2026-10-18 09:12, Emma Chen wrote:
> > Jonas / Marissa,
> > 
> > Thanks for scheduling next week’s demo. Two important updates from our side:
> > ...

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.example.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>, BluePeak Procurement <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: expand demo audience — security & procurement added

Hi Emma — looping in quick logistics so we can lock a time today.

We’ll prepare a short procurement packet and a security appendix for the product demo. To make execution simple, I recommend we: 
1) Hold a 20–30m procurement pre‑call to cover contract cadence and deliverables (we’ll include a draft timeline and clause list).
2) Then run a 60–75m integrated demo with Security and Platform present.

Concrete times (PT) — please pick one: 
- Option 1 (preferred): Fri 2026‑10‑29 09:00–10:15 PT — procurement pre‑call at 08:30–08:50, integrated demo 09:00–10:15
- Option 2: Sat 2026‑10‑30 11:00–12:15 PT — procurement pre‑call at 10:30–10:50, integrated demo 11:00–12:15

If Luca is still travelling then Option 2 might still be tight; if that’s the case we’ll do the split session on Thu 10/28 + Fri 10/29 as Jonas suggested. We’ll also circulate the mutual action plan ahead of time (link below) and a 6‑minute recorded product preview for any traveling stakeholders.

Link to MAP and draft timeline: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-BluePeak-v2

I’ll update the invite once you confirm which option works for the stakeholders.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
+1 650‑555‑0133

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx (stub)

From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@bluepeak.com>

Cc: BluePeak Procurement <procurement@bluepeak.com>, Mark Alvarez <mark.alvarez@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: expand demo audience — security & procurement added

Marissa / Jonas — thanks for the quick options. We’ll take Option 1 (Fri 2026‑10‑29 09:00–10:15 PT) with the procurement pre‑call at 08:30. That time works for Security, Platform, and Procurement (Mark copied).

Two quick asks before you send updated invites: 
- Can you circulate a short procurement packet (SLA, pricing bands, basic termination/usage terms) ahead of the pre‑call? Procurement wants the doc for their review.
- Security would like the network architecture appendix and a KMS/HSM checklist in advance.

If you can drop those by EOD Thu 10/28 that gives our teams time to review. Otherwise the 6‑minute recorded preview is fine as a backup.

Appreciate the flexibility — Emma

Emma Chen
Senior PM, BluePeak Health
emma.chen@bluepeak.com
